Module com.example._0zo
Package com.example._0zo.model.game

Class TurnManager

java.lang.Object
com.example._0zo.model.game.TurnManager
public class TurnManager extends Object
Manages turn execution and timing in the poker game. This class orchestrates the flow of player turns using background threads. It handles both human players (waiting for UI input) and computer players (with artificial delays for realism). Card play and drawing are communicated to the UI via event listeners.

  • Method Details

    • startGame

      public void startGame()
      Starts the game turn loop in a background thread. Initializes the scheduler for machine player delays and starts the main turn loop that processes each player's turn.

    • submitHumanCard

      public void submitHumanCard(Card card)
      Submits a card selected by a human player to the turn queue. This is called from the UI when the human player clicks a card to play.
      Parameters:
      card - the card selected by the human player

    • stopGame

      public void stopGame()
      Stops the game and all related threads. Shuts down the scheduler and interrupts the turn thread.
